Class ACQ_Query

  • java.lang.Object
    • ag.ACQ_Query

  • public class ACQ_Query
extends java.lang.Object
    A query is a potential solution that is submitted to the solver. It can be a positive or a negative example. It contains a scope (the variables involved) and a set of values for these variables.
    Author:
    LAZAAR
